meta.name: media-processing
meta.description: Process multimedia files with FFmpeg (video/audio encoding, conversion, streaming, filtering, hardware acceleration) and ImageMagick (image manipulation, format conversion, batch processing, effects, composition). Use when converting media formats, encoding videos with specific codecs (H.264, H.265, VP9), resizing/cropping images, extracting audio from video, applying filters and effects, optimizing file sizes, creating streaming manifests (HLS/DASH), generating thumbnails, batch processing images, creating composite images, or implementing media processing pipelines. Supports 100+ formats, hardware acceleration (NVENC, QSV), and complex filtergraphs.

copy.tagline: 用 FFmpeg 和 ImageMagick 处理音视频与图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理多媒体文件格式转换、编码或滤镜效果
copy.tagline_en: Process audio, video, and images with FFmpeg and ImageMagick
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert, encode, or apply filters to multimedia files

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 FFmpeg 和 ImageMagick 处理多媒体文件，包括视频/音频编码、格式转换、流媒体、滤镜、硬件加速，以及图像编辑、批量处理、合成等。
howto.when: 当你要求转换媒体格式、编码视频（如 H.264）、处理图片（缩放、裁剪）、提取音频、生成缩略图、批量处理或创建流媒体清单时触发。

say.text: 把这个视频转成 MP4，用 H.264 编码。
say.note: Claude 会生成 FFmpeg 命令并执行。

say.text: 把这张图片缩小到 800 像素宽。
say.note: Claude 会使用 ImageMagick 调整尺寸。

say.text: 提取这个视频的音频并保存为 MP3。
say.note: Claude 会运行音频提取命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process multimedia files using FFmpeg and ImageMagick, including video/audio encoding, format conversion, streaming, filtering, hardware acceleration, image editing, batch processing, and composition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert media formats, encode video (e.g., H.264), process images (resize, crop), extract audio, generate thumbnails, batch process, or create streaming manifests.

say_en.text: Convert this video to MP4 with H.264.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and run an FFmpeg command.

say_en.text: Resize this image to 800 pixels wide.
say_en.note: Claude will use ImageMagick to resize.

say_en.text: Extract audio from this video as MP3.
say_en.note: Claude will run audio extraction command.
